name: Breakfast protein bar
ingredients: Whole Grains 20% (Rolled Oats 10%, Brown Rice, Foxtail millet 6%, Quinoa 4%), Seeds 17% (Sunflower, Sesame, Flax, Watermelon, Pumpkin, Chia), Honey, Prebiotic fibre (Fructo-oligosaccharide), Nuts (Almonds 7%, Peanuts), Rice crisps, Soy crisps, Dried Cranberry, Dried Blueberry 2%, Banana & Strawberry puree. Apple fibre, Gum Acacia, Himalayan pink salt. CONTAINS ADDED NATURAL FLAVOUR (Rosemary extract, Blueberry extract)
